items.example: The city needs more green spaces where residents can relax.
Being in blue space has effects similar to green spaces.
People feel happier when they spend time close to water.
The same computer works in a bright, well-lit space or a dark corner.
In urban settings, even a fountain can help people relax.
Water has a particular ability to reduce stress.
Being near the sea makes us feel optimistic.
A waterway helps people feel destressed and revived.
Some families move out of cities to coastal towns.
Coastal towns attract people who are tired of city life.
Our surroundings affect the way we behave towards each other.
Streets with cafes and seating provide active edges.
Streets with blank walls have inactive edges.
On lively streets we are more likely to engage with people.
We need to feel that we will fit in to work well.
We perform better with a sense of ownership of a place.
We work best surrounded by things which reflect our personality and interests.
Students in the new classroom expressed an interest in science.
